name: ts-lsp
description: TypeScript-only LSP via vtsls, with LSP-first enforcement hooks

enforce_search.title: Enforce LSP over text search (TypeScript)
enforce_search.description: Redirect Grep/Glob/Bash-grep for TypeScript code symbols to the LSP tool. Fail-open: disabled only when set to false. (Boolean, Default: true)

enforce_read_gate.title: Progressive read gate (TypeScript)
enforce_read_gate.description: Require an LSP navigation call before reading many TypeScript files (warmup -> surgical mode). Because it creates per-project state, it is fail-closed at runtime — only a literal true value activates it (an uninterpolated placeholder is treated as off). (Boolean, Default: true)
